title: Plum and Star Anise Chicken Thighs
description: Ripe plums and a briefly steeped star anise pod make a mild, glossy glaze for chicken thighs braised in a lidded wok.
equipment: Immersion blender and deep heatproof jug

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Use plain, unenhanced poultry. Remove visible fat before weighing.

ingredients.name: ripe red plum flesh
ingredients.note: Peeled and pitted weight; roughly chop. Unsweetened thawed plums also work.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain chicken-and-water broth without a vegetable blend or added seasoning.

ingredients.name: small whole culinary star anise pod
ingredients.note: Leave intact for removal. Remove before serving.

ingredients.name: fresh ginger juice
ingredients.note: Press finely grated ginger and leave out the fibers.

steps.title: Poach the plums
steps.text: Simmer {plum}, {broth} and {anise} in the HexClad wok, covered, over medium-low. Remove and discard the whole pod after 2 minutes; let the fruit soften for another 3 minutes.

steps.title: Braise the thighs
steps.text: Cut {chicken} across the grain into 1-inch pieces and nestle into the liquid at the base of the wok. Cover and simmer gently for 10–17 minutes, turning halfway. Pull each piece at 175°F and keep it covered with a spoonful of juice.

steps.title: Puree the plum glaze
steps.text: Blend the cooked plums and braising liquid in a deep heatproof jug, then strain back into the wok and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Balance the glaze
steps.text: Stir {aminos}, {ginger} and {maple} into the boiled base. Reduce to about 5/8 cup of sauce per serving.

steps.title: Bind the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and let it bubble gently for 1 minute, stirring until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Glaze the chicken
steps.text: Off heat, fold the thigh pieces and their resting juices into the glaze. Spoon the extra glaze over each portion.

notes: Sauce yield: About 1 1/4 cups for two. Make ahead: Peel and pit the plums ahead; refrigerate covered, or freeze them if fresh plums are especially good. Option A uses plum and a short star anise infusion. For gentler Option B, use ripe peeled pear, omit the ginger and skip the star anise. Chill leftovers promptly in shallow portions and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. The fruit glaze keeps thigh pieces coated for up to 2 months in the freezer. Fridge reheat: Warm one portion covered in its sauce in a HexClad skillet over medium-low, loosening with a splash of water if needed. Stir or turn the chicken gently, checking from 6 minutes, until it reaches 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then follow the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 230 kcal, 29.3 g protein, 13.4 g total carbohydrate, 6.0 g fat, 0.8 g fiber, 198 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
